source.title: Ulster Herald, 21 May 1949, p. 5 ("Four contests in Omagh rural election")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: Triennial election of the 16 electoral divisions of Clogher rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There was no contest: eleven Unionists and five Nationalists were nominated. The Ulster Herald names the five new members. New member. Returned unopposed.
